results.assertion: With JavaScript network requests blocked but HTML/CSS allowed, every Experience duration bar must retain a non-collapsed computed transform and visible painted width.
results.actual: First bar computed scaleX was 0; assertion expected >= 0.95. Layout width was present but the painted duration axis collapsed.
results.reproRoot: components/sections/Experience/Experience.module.css sets .trackBar transform: scaleX(0) and only .trackField[data-entered] .trackBar restores scaleX(1); components/sections/Experience/Experience.tsx sets data-entered from client IntersectionObserver state, so blocked JavaScript leaves the static axis visually empty.

results.assertion: After focusing a nested Vitrine stage button, pressing ArrowRight must not bubble into the parent plate rail roving-focus handler; focus should remain on that stage button.
results.actual: Locator for the focused stage button became inactive after ArrowRight; expected focused.
results.reproRoot: components/sections/Vitrine/Vitrine.tsx attaches onKeyDown to each focusable plate li; nested stage buttons do not stop ArrowRight propagation, so the plate handler runs for descendant key presses.

results.assertion: Vitrine stage buttons must expose selected/unselected state with aria-pressed=true/false.
results.actual: Default selected stage button rendered as <button type="button" data-active="" class="Vitrine_stageButton__aeLPm">claim</button>; aria-pressed was absent/null, expected "true".
results.reproRoot: components/sections/Vitrine/Vitrine.tsx marks selected stages with data-active only; no aria-pressed state is emitted on stage buttons.

results.assertion: At 320px viewport width, the mobile Menu button bounding rect must be at least 24 CSS px tall.
results.actual: Menu target height was 19.5 CSS px; expected >= 24. Width satisfied the floor.
results.reproRoot: components/site/Navigation.tsx renders .menu-toggle; app/globals.css .menu-toggle has inline-flex text/icon styling without a min-height/padding that guarantees the 24px touch target floor at phone widths.

results.assertion: At 390px viewport width, the mobile Menu button bounding rect must be at least 24 CSS px tall.
results.actual: Menu target height was 19.5 CSS px; expected >= 24. Width satisfied the floor.
results.reproRoot: Same .menu-toggle CSS target-size root as C4-MENU-TARGET-320; the measured height remains 19.5px at 390px.
